CHAPTER.VERS: For I truly, being absent in body but present in spirit, have already as though I were present judged him who has so worked this thing,
to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord.
therefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
But those who are outside God will judge. Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.
